run_plot_world_pair: run the script to plot optimal transport plans for world pairs using Sinkhorn or learned transport
run_plot_world_pair_with_tag: run the script with a custom pickle tag to load a specific experiment checkpoint
run_plot_world_pair_samples: run the script with a custom number of test samples to generate comparison plots
review_plot_function: review the plot function that visualizes geodesic transport paths between supply and demand locations on a sphere
review_sinkhorn_solver: review the Sinkhorn solver configuration used to compute optimal transport plans for world pairs
